notes: mood_distribution keys are JSON STRINGS of the int mood values, and only moods actually logged appear. average_mood is round(x,2) (float). first_entry_date/last_entry_date are MIN(date)/MAX(date) on the RAW stored strings (SQL unchanged, still lexicographic). current_streak is 0 because no entry is today/yesterday. contract change: US-format input dates are normalized to ISO before storage (write path + version-2 bootstrap migration), so the entry POSTed as '8/2/2025' is stored as '2025-08-02' and last_entry_date is now the chronologically correct '2025-08-03' instead of the lexicographic US string '8/2/2025'.
